dataset.marginPolicy: Random training, validation, and test pairs are retained only when abs(ruleScore) > 512. Boundary cases are evaluated separately.
dataset.pairing: Each accepted generated scenario is paired with its exact reflection around all feature midpoints, producing the opposite rule score and exact class balance.

split.method: Pair-preserving deterministic shuffle, followed by disjoint slicing.

features.name: limitRoomBps
features.provenance: Bounded public market/ticket feature: distance inside the user-approved limit.

features.name: recentMoveOffsetBps
features.provenance: Bounded public market feature: recent public price movement offset by 1000.

features.name: roundProgressBps
features.provenance: Bounded public market feature: progress through the public round.

features.name: freshnessSeconds
features.provenance: Bounded public market feature: age of the public snapshot.

features.name: bufferCategory
features.provenance: Approved coarse preference category; exact buffer values are never training inputs.

features.name: horizonCategory
features.provenance: Approved coarse preference category; exact horizon values are never training inputs.

labelRule.decision: EXECUTE when ruleScore > 0; WAIT when ruleScore <= 0.
labelRule.purpose: Synthetic decision-consistency supervision only. It is not a profitability target or a validated financial prediction.

training.method: Two deterministic torch.linalg.lstsq fits: normalized features to signed rule score, then eight ReLU activations to two class logits.
training.normalization: Feature midpoint and half-range from the declared bounded domains; folded into the first learned layer before export.
